reviews.review:
I've completed over 600 hidden object games, and this has to be one of the most frustrating experiences. 

In general, the game is fine. There's 150 cats to locate and a number of additional puzzles to solve, including a block sliding puzzle, colour matching and memory game. There's also a number of cats which can only be found when you complete a fetch quest - e.g. locate 5 worms, 20 crabs etc. And this is where the frustration comes in.

I managed to get to 148 cats in about an hour. It then took me an additional 5.5 hours to find a single heart to unlock the last 2 cats. 5.5 hours! There's several very obvious hearts around the game which do no count at all, and I eventually found the last heart ... somewhere. I resulted to randomly clicking around the screen and at some point clicked on the final heart without knowing.

Along the way I reset the game twice. First by accident - if you press the Delete key whilst the game is open it erases all of your data without any confirmation/warning. The second time I reset on purpose in case the heart was glitched or more obvious when no cats were moving on the screen. The real kicker? I now want to reset my game to play it again an properly find the last heart. But now I'm at 100% completion the delete key no longer works. So now I can't replay the game, even after deleting the files or uninstalling. 

In the process, I did make a guide to hopefully help other players have a far less frustrating experience. I may even use a second PC to play it some more to try and locate that final heart and offer hints on some of the other puzzles/well hidden cats. But I've had such a sour relationship with this game because of a single item.

Interested in other Hidden Object Games? Check out the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/groups/HiddenObjectDoodles"]Hidden Object Doodles[/url] group and [url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44861109/"]Curator[/url] page.
